item.title: The STRANGE Jenson Huang Exit, and the "Pick Another Protein" Win, with Sean Davis and Sohrab Ahmari, Plus Shock Chris Watts Prison Behavior | Ep. 1440 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Sean Davis, CEO of The Federalist, and Sohrab Ahmari, U.S. editor of UnHerd, to discuss the strange circumstances behind Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang being pushed out of his own company, allegations involving affairs with a potential Chinese spy and a direct report, whether there's more to the story still to come, the GOP establishment not learning its lesson and still calling for Americans to make sacrifices amid the war with Iran, the impact of rising diesel prices on the global economy, why cost of living messaging favored the Dems in 2026, Democrat Scott Colom’s shock victory in Mississippi, how terrible the “pick another protein” messaging was for the GOP candidate, Trump’s decision to move Vice President JD Vance’s off Iran peace talks and toward addressing fraud, what the move could signal about Vance's future, massive national media coverage of an alleged racial incident at Ole Miss, the hypocritical lack of national coverage for black on white crimes, Dianna Russini’s attempted comeback after her alleged affair with a football coach source, her rebrand as a "girl boss" victim, and more. Then Megyn closes out discussing convicted murderer Chris Watts’ shocking life in prison, reports about his s*xual relationships with male inmates, and more.
